en: A vintage botanical postcard featuring a monochrome illustration of branches, leaves, blossoms, and berries of a pepper tree. The plant fills most of the card, printed in dark ink on a light background. Around the image are printed captions in red: a title at the bottom describing the subject and publisher/printing information along the sides. A handwritten red number is visible along the left edge.
